rules.title: Friendly and warm
rules.body: Write like a friendly neighbour: short sentences, speak to the reader as you, no jargon.

rules.title: No shouting
rules.body: No all-caps words for emphasis and no more than one exclamation mark per post.

rules.title: Product name
rules.body: Always write the product name exactly as FreshBrew Gold.

rules.title: Say affordable
rules.body: Use the word affordable. Never use cheap.

rules.title: No absolute claims
rules.body: Do not use best, world's best, number one or guaranteed unless an approved fact supports it.

rules.title: No health claims
rules.body: Do not say our coffee cures, treats or prevents any condition, or boosts immunity.

rules.title: Offers need dates
rules.body: Any discount or offer must state its end date and be confirmed by a reviewer.

rules.title: Numbers must match
rules.body: Any number about sourcing, stores, founding year or delivery must match an approved fact exactly.

rules.title: Alt text
rules.body: Every image needs alt text: one clear sentence that describes what is shown.

rules.title: Clear links and hashtags
rules.body: Never use click here as link text. Write hashtags in CamelCase, for example #FreshBrewMorning.

rules.title: Logo and colours
rules.body: Use only the official FreshBrew logo and the brand colours cream, espresso brown and gold.

facts.statement: FreshBrew beans come from three countries: Colombia, Ethiopia and Brazil.

terms.note: Never describe our prices as cheap
